title: cacalia tarchonanthifolia
intro: Cacalia tarchonanthifolia, commonly known as Mountain Fleabane, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, characterized by its perennial nature and woody stem. The health benefits of Cacalia tarchonanthifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to exhibit antioxidant, analgesic, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia tarchonanthifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
